assertions.name: A low-pitch roof exports as one closed printable component
Quarter-turn rotation previews through the canvas control
Handles follow the browser fullscreen element
Handles return to the page after leaving fullscreen
Repeated arrow keys accumulate grid steps
Cancel resets the next keyboard move to one cell
Touch dragging previews without placing or breaking blocks
Exiting touch manipulation removes the overlay
Visibility filtering excludes a block hidden directly behind another
Planted apron faces upward and courtyard keeps three draw calls
Welcome navigation remains available after direct editing

scope: Local Chromium, real WebGL, fullscreen and emulated touch.
